Done. The pruned checkpoint is written and the plan passes all required checks.

**What the plan does** (`out/T2/plan.yaml`): for each of the 12 layers, it rebuilds the three head-bearing tensors by concatenating the kept slices into a temporary name, deleting the original, and moving the temporary back to the original name. The fused `c_attn.weight` and bias drop columns 320..383 from each of the query, key and value segments. The `c_proj.weight` drops rows 320..383. The plan ends with the four required asserts plus extra asserts that every layer has the pruned shapes and that no temporary tensor remains.

**Result**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Output | `out/T2/model.safetensors`, 160 tensors |
| Executions | 3, all exit code 0, no assertion failures |
| Plan lines (non-blank, non-comment) | 122 |

Two of the three executions were re-runs of the unchanged plan to capture the exit code and log tail, which I recorded in the self-report. The report is at `out/T2/REPORT.md`. I did not run the grader, since it lives outside the sandbox.
